name: Spam Comment Remover
author: Sahil Dadwal

sections.description:
Spam Comment Remover automatically detects and removes spam comments from your WordPress site.
It works silently in the background, ensuring your website remains free from unwanted comments.

Key Features:
– Automatically removes spam comments on your site.
– Cleans spam and pending comments upon plugin activation.
– Ignores and preserves admin-approved comments.
– Works without any setup or configuration.
– Lightweight and fast – no impact on performance.

How It Works:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
2. All existing spam and pending comments will be deleted instantly.
3. New spam comments are automatically removed before they appear.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the spam-comment-remover folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install via the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. That’s it! The plugin will start removing spam comments automatically.
sections.faq:
Does it delete approved comments?

No. Approved comments will never be deleted.

Does it work with WooCommerce product reviews?

Yes, it works with all WordPress comment systems, including WooCommerce reviews.

Is there any setup required?

No setup needed – just install and activate.
